security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: What is true about every project on this machine
bundle.longDescription: Project Observatory watches the projects, repositories, agents and services on one machine and shows what is true about them: what exists, what changed, what is at risk. This app opens its dashboard, starts its local server and keeps its settings. Open source under the GNU AGPL-3.0; a commercial license is available. Part of the PassionCode.ai toolkit.
